_help: Edited by hand when news breaks; the collector never touches it. 'copyable' turns true once there's a public way to copy (dump) GTA 6 off a PS5, which emulators need before anyone can test it. Keep every claim sourced, say 'reported' for anything Rockstar or Sony hasn't confirmed, and never link to exploits, payloads or jailbreak tools.
copy_blocker: GTA 6 reportedly needs PS5 firmware 14.10 or newer. Copying a PS5 game off the console takes a hypervisor exploit, and none is public for 14.10: the last known one works only up to firmware 13.60 and was reported to Sony.
firmware: GTA 6's PlayStation Store listing reportedly requires firmware 14.10 or newer. That comes from a datamine; Rockstar and Sony haven't confirmed it.
pc_version: Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. GamesBeat reports one for early 2027, citing four industry sources.
